title: A checked rectangle
description:
Write a class `Rect` with `width` and `height` accessors and a read-only `area`:

- `new Rect(width, height)` sets both through the setters.
- Setting `width` or `height` to anything that is not a positive finite number throws a `RangeError`.
- `area` is computed from the current sizes and has no setter.
hints: Keep the real values in private fields (`#width`), and write a `get width()` / `set width(value)` pair. One shared checking function keeps the two setters short.
`Number.isFinite(value)` is false for `Infinity`, `NaN` and anything that is not a number.
